title: Surrounded Regions
summary: Replace every O that lacks an orthogonal path of O cells to the board boundary with X.

contractDetails.constraints: A rectangular board with 1–200 rows and columns. Each entry is the single letter X or O.
contractDetails.callable: `solve` mutates the board and returns no value outside R. The runner serializes the mutated input. R returns the updated board.

statement: Replace every O that lacks an orthogonal path of O cells to the board boundary with X. Keep existing X cells and all boundary-connected O cells. Mutate the supplied board where supported. In R, return the updated board.

examples.explanation: The center has no path to an edge.
Every entry is on the boundary of a single-row board.
The interior O survives through the O to its left.

constraints: A rectangular board with 1–200 rows and columns. Each entry is the single letter X or O.
hints: Conceptual: A region that touches the boundary survives.
Directional: Flood-fill from boundary O cells to mark the cells that survive.
Implementation: Sweep the board after the flood fill and replace every unmarked O with X.
complexityAnalysis: O(rows × columns) time and space for flood fill and visited marks.
